# Seapee Bajaj

> B2B SEO content strategist with 10+ years of experience in market research content, SEO, GEO and AI search.

## Services
- B2B SEO content strategy and writing
- Market research content
- GEO and AEO (Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization)
- Editorial strategy and content audits

## About & Background
Seapee Bajaj has 10+ years of professional experience spanning market research, B2B content creation, on-page SEO, and editorial management. She has worked across leading research and content organizations including IMARC Group, Grand View Research, The Insight Partners, Allied Market Research, and Perfect Clicks LLC. She holds an MBA in Systems, is certified in HubSpot Content Marketing, and has completed professional training in Generative Engine Optimization (Coursera), Google Prompting Essentials, and AI workflow tools.

She is also the author of the published poetry collection "Not Unworthy" (Notion Press, December 2020), exploring everyday courage, consistency, and resilience.
